related_resources.reason: Residue theorem and evaluation of real definite integrals.
Derivation of residues from Laurent coefficients.
Kilpeläinen & Vähäkangas, Complex Analysis 2, chapter 3: residue theorem and applications.

description: Derives the residue theorem from Laurent coefficients and contour deformation, computes residues at several kinds of singularities, and evaluates improper real integrals using semicircular contours and arc bounds.
